_note: Tegneopgaveliste til kapitel 1. Al grafik tegnes af Claude som SVG i koden. 'beskrivelse' er motivet (skrevet på engelsk), 'tags'/'traek' skal kunne ses på tegningen, og 'reference' angiver motiver, personen skal ligne. 'stil' og 'format' er retningslinjer. En fil <id>.png/.svg i denne mappe overstyrer den kodetegnede version.

stil.tegning: Warm hand-drawn European comic-book illustration, clean confident ink outlines, flat soft colors with a subtle paper texture, friendly expressive faces, gentle humor. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
stil.foto: Warm hand-drawn European comic-book illustration with clean ink outlines, styled as an antique photograph: sepia and brown tones, slightly faded, soft vignette, worn rounded paper corners. Still clearly a drawing, not photorealistic. No text, no letters, no watermark.

format.portraet: Square 1:1 image, head-and-shoulders portrait, centered, plain softly colored background.
format.genstand: Square 1:1 image, a single object centered on an old wooden desk, seen slightly from above.
format.baggrund: Vertical 9:16 image for a mobile phone screen, wide scene with empty space in the lower third for game interface.

billeder.beskrivelse: Character reference sheet of one young Danish man, 19 years old, around 1916. Shown twice side by side: facing front and three-quarter view. Key features that must be clearly visible: a distinct cleft chin, noticeably protruding ears, short light-blond hair, and a thin pale scar cutting vertically through his LEFT eyebrow (that is, on the right side of the image as we look at him). Clean-shaven, serious but gentle eyes, plain collarless shirt. Neutral light background.

A 23-year-old young man from a fishing town on the Danish west coast. Weathered, calm face, short dark-blond hair tousled by wind, noticeably protruding ears, a dry half-smile. Wears a navy knitted fisherman's sweater. Background: soft grey-blue sea sky.

A 24-year-old charming, talkative young man from a small Danish border town. Big open grin, sparkling eyes, a clear cleft chin, wavy brown hair. Wears a casual flannel shirt over a t-shirt. Background: warm soft yellow.

A 22-year-old enthusiastic nerdy young man from a Danish city. Rectangular glasses, messy dark hair, eager wide eyes, slightly excited expression as if about to explain something. Wears a hoodie with a pen clipped to the collar. Background: soft mint green.

A 25-year-old dreamy storyteller from rural North Jutland. Longish light-blond hair, short beard, thoughtful gentle gaze looking slightly away, a faint smile. Wears a worn corduroy jacket. Background: soft dusky lavender.

A 21-year-old energetic, practical young salesman type from mid-Jutland. Short neat hair, confident grin, protruding ears and a cleft chin, giving a thumbs-up. Wears a quilted vest over a polo shirt. Background: soft orange.

An 81-year-old kind Danish grandfather, slightly forgetful and wistful. Thin white hair, deep smile lines, a cleft chin and protruding ears inherited from his father (see reference image – family resemblance, but he has NO scar). Wears a grey cardigan over a checked shirt and holds a coffee cup. Background: warm soft beige living room blur.

Formal Danish wedding photograph from 1925. The groom is the same man as in the reference image, now 28: same cleft chin, protruding ears, light-blond hair and thin scar through his LEFT eyebrow (right side of the image as we look at him), now with a small neat moustache. Dark suit, serious expression. The bride Karen Marie, 25, with a gentle smile, light dress and veil, holding a small bouquet. Studio backdrop with a painted column.

Photograph from 1945 of the same man as in the reference image, now 48: greying blond hair, moustache, cleft chin, protruding ears and the thin scar through his LEFT eyebrow. He carefully holds a newborn baby wrapped in a blanket, with a tender but sad expression.

Small portrait photograph of a young Danish woman around 1925, about 25 years old. Hair in a low bun, gentle shy smile, high-collared blouse with a small brooch. The photo looks well-handled, kept in a drawer for many years.

A cheerful 71-year-old Danish woman from Esbjerg. Short curly grey hair, round glasses on a chain, warm excited smile. Wears a colorful knitted cardigan and holds a folder of family papers. Background: soft pink.

A friendly 58-year-old American woman from Nebraska of Danish descent. Shoulder-length blonde hair, big enthusiastic smile, denim jacket, a small Danish flag pin. Holds an old family bible. Background: soft sky blue.

A 76-year-old retired Danish schoolteacher. Neat white beard, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead, tweed jacket with elbow patches, slightly formal but kind expression. Holds a cardboard box of old documents. Background: soft olive green.
Rural Danish woman around 1895, about 40 years old. Hair parted in the middle under a dark headscarf, strong hard-working hands folded, calm proud expression. Dark simple dress with an apron.

Danish immigrant blacksmith around 1885 in Omaha, Nebraska, about 41 years old. Big beard, leather apron, rolled-up sleeves, standing proudly in front of his wooden blacksmith workshop with an anvil and horseshoes. A younger man (his brother) leans in the doorway.
Young Danish farmer's son around 1910, 21 years old. Dark hair combed with a side parting, his best Sunday suit a bit too large, stiff proud pose.
An old thatched four-winged Danish farmhouse in flat marshland near Ribe around 1800. Whitewashed walls, half-timbering, a stork's nest on the roof, a cart in the courtyard, wide sky.

Young soldier, 19, in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Dark hair, a cleft chin, protruding ears and a small scar ABOVE HIS UPPER LIP. No scar on the eyebrows. Neutral expression.

Young soldier, 20, in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Light-blond hair, small moustache, protruding ears and a thin scar through his RIGHT eyebrow (left side of the image as we look at him). Round chin with NO cleft.

The same young man as in the reference image, 19, now in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Same cleft chin, protruding ears, light-blond hair and thin scar through his LEFT eyebrow (right side of the image as we look at him). Clean-shaven, a quiet, uneasy expression.
Young soldier, 21, in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Narrow face, round wire glasses, light hair, small ears close to the head, no scars, a shy smile.
Young soldier, 20, in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Light hair, a clear cleft chin, but SMALL ears close to the head and NO scars anywhere. Friendly face.
Young soldier, 22, in a German First World War field-grey uniform with a round cap, 1916. Round chubby face, dark hair, thick dark moustache, no scars, cheerful expression.

Group photograph from 1916 of six young soldiers in German First World War field-grey uniforms standing in one row in front of a village church wall, in this exact order from left to right: the six men in the reference images, number 1 to 6. Serious faces, some with arms on each other's shoulders.
An old worn silver pocket watch lying open, with a short chain. The inside of the lid has a fine engraving (shown only as decorative swirls, no readable letters).
A small old sepia group photograph of six young soldiers in a row, lying on the desk. The face of the THIRD man from the left has been carefully cut out with scissors, leaving a neat oval hole.

An old unsent postcard from around 1918 with a picture of a tall red-brick Romanesque cathedral with a tower in a small Danish town. The address area has been crossed out with ink scribbles (no readable text).

A small black hymn book with a worn leather cover lying open at the first page, where an elegant handwritten inscription has been partly rubbed out with an eraser (shown as faded scribbles, no readable text).

A single loose, yellowed, torn-off page from an old German military pay book, with printed form lines and faded handwriting (shown as illegible scribbles, no readable text) and an official round stamp.

A small, slightly shabby genealogy office in an old Ribe townhouse, just inherited. A single wooden desk with an old lamp, stacks of dusty boxes, an empty bookshelf, a crooked window with a view of red-tiled rooftops. Cozy but sparse.

The same genealogy office as in the reference image, but now tidier and more alive: a bookshelf filled with archive binders, a world map on the wall with pins, a magnifying glass on the desk, a coffee machine, a plant in the window.

The same genealogy office as in the reference image, now fully grown: a large family-tree wall with photos and red strings, a framed old group photo of soldiers, a comfortable armchair for clients, warm lamplight in the evening.

A cozy Danish living room of an 81-year-old man: a worn armchair by the window, a coffee table with a thermos and cups, a dresser with family photos in frames, a ticking wall clock, net curtains, soft afternoon light.

Title screen scene: the five young cousins from the reference images standing together, curious and excited, leaning over an old open wooden chest full of letters, photographs and a pocket watch. Behind them, a faint ghostly sepia silhouette of a young soldier looks over their shoulders. Leave the top third as calm sky for the game title.
A small whitewashed medieval village church in flat Danish marshland in late autumn 1899, with a churchyard of simple grave crosses and bare trees. Grey sky, a few crows. Quiet and melancholic.

Night scene in autumn 1917: a small winding river through flat meadows marking a border, mist over the water, a wooden border post in the distance. A lone young man (seen from behind, light hair, civilian clothes, a small bundle on his back) wades carefully through the shallow river by moonlight.

A cobblestone street in the old Danish town of Ribe in 1925, crooked half-timbered houses with red tile roofs, the tall brick tower of the cathedral in the background, a bicycle leaning on a wall, people in 1920s clothing.
